title: My dreamworld is getting more remote but fancier!
content: My house last night was a river/lake house on a hill. It wasn’t the top of the hill, but the grass was nice like a golf course, and the house was big and had lights outside. I was nervous about the river on one side but I liked the lake on the other, it was on a peninsula? There was a nice boat house with zero spiders and good lighting and I showed a few people to my NEW INVENTION THAT I ALREADY HAD PROTOTYPED. (Can’t tell you details on that but I really just dreamed them last night). There were two pools, one was heated but not like a hot tub and the other was not heated. Something was wrong with the driveway and my brother kept using my bathroom (he didn’t live there). Lots of people were around, but I was always a little nervous about people falling in the river or getting hurt. I never felt like I owned the house but I knew it was mine. No dogs or cats, it was always night time but there were plenty of lights.
